related.title: Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新；Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究改以公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal; Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research centers on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Wairakei資源與歷史與EGS熱與連通，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以更新環境與階段證據為起點，設計一項能區分「既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新」與「公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare wairakei resources/history with egs heat/connectivity and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from renewal environment/stages and propose an observation distinguishing existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal from public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles, including uncertainty.

related.title: Krafla 地熱與回注系統
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新；Krafla 地熱與回注系統改以火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal; Krafla geothermal and reinjection system centers on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Wairakei資源與歷史與Krafla儲層觀測，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Krafla 地熱與回注系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以更新環境與階段證據為起點，設計一項能區分「既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新」與「火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare wairakei resources/history with krafla reservoir observations and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Krafla geothermal and reinjection system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from renewal environment/stages and propose an observation distinguishing existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal from volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 懷拉基地熱電站
history.text: Contact 的公開更新計畫描述 Te Mihi Stage 2 雙循環新機組及 Wairākei 分期退役；本課比較熱循環，不把預計商轉日期當成已達成。
history.textEn: Contact’s plan describes Te Mihi Stage 2 binary units and staged Wairākei retirement; projected dates are not treated as completed commissioning.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
